A copper-alloy Roman sestertius of Antoninus Pius (AD 138-161), dating to the period c.AD 143-161 (Reece Period 7). Unclear reverse type depicting a seated female figure left, possibly Britannia. Mint of Rome. cf. RIC III nos. 744-745. The diameter is 34mm, thickness 4mm, and the weight 18.3g. Obverse inscription [ANT]ONINVS AVG [PI]VS P P T[R P COS III], Laureate head right. Reverse inscription [BRITAN](NIA) (in exergue), S C, Female figure seated left, possibly Britannia
